community_list_entries.name: Persona-MME: A Benchmark for Long-Term Personalized Multimodal LLMs

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Benchmark from the PersonaVLM paper (CVPR 2026) with 2,034 cases over long multimodal user histories (up to 128k). It spans 7 aspects including memory recall, latest-preference recognition and interest evolution.
